command: cd /code && mkdir -p ../results && jupyter nbconvert --to html --execute FS-Filters.ipynb --ExecutePreprocessor.allow_errors=True --ExecutePreprocessor.timeout=-1 --FilesWriter.build_directory=../results > /tmp/nb.out 2> /tmp/nb.err; status=$?; echo STATUS:$status; echo '---STDOUT---'; sed -n '1,120p' /tmp/nb.out; echo '---STDERR---'; sed -n '1,200p' /tmp/nb.err; ls -la ../results
